2607.13647.title: Beyond Color Geometry: Evaluating Human-Like Color Representations in Vision Models
2607.13647.paper_summary: Do vision models see colors the way humans do? Existing evaluations of color representations usually compare them with geometric spaces such as CIELAB or with discrete color labels. These references capture perceptual distance or category membership, but not the graded way in which people organize colors. We evaluate color grounding against a fuzzy perceptual model with 86 graded categories fitted to human survey data. The framework can be applied to any image encoder and measures three complementary properties: category boundaries, category compactness, and graded alignment beyond what color geometry alone can explain. Across eleven Vision Transformer encoders, the category-level results are broadly similar, whereas graded alignment differs substantially. Masked Autoencoders achieve the strongest beyond-geometry alignment, with confidence intervals that do not overlap those of the other encoders. A layer-wise analysis further shows that masked reconstruction preserves this structure toward the output. On natural images, MAE represents surface color globally, while language-supervised models encode color more strongly in relation to the foreground object. These results show that human-like color grounding has several distinct aspects that should not be reduced to a single score.
2607.13647.paper_summary_zh: 視覺模型是否以人類的方式看待顏色？現有的顏色表示評估通常將其與幾何空間（如 CIELAB）或離散顏色標籤進行比較。這些參考捕捉了感知距離或類別成員資格，但並未反映人們組織顏色的漸進方式。我們針對一個模糊的感知模型評估顏色基礎，該模型具有 86 個根據人類調查數據擬合的漸進類別。該框架可以應用於任何圖像編碼器，並測量三個互補的屬性：類別邊界、類別緊湊性，以及超出顏色幾何所能解釋的漸進對齊。在十一個視覺轉換器編碼器中，類別層級的結果大致相似，而漸進對齊則有顯著差異。遮罩自編碼器在幾何之外的對齊上表現最強，其置信區間不重疊其他編碼器的置信區間。逐層分析進一步顯示，遮罩重建在輸出時保留了這一結構。在自然圖像上，MAE 全球性地表示表面顏色，而語言監督模型則在與前景物體的關係中更強烈地編碼顏色。這些結果顯示，人類般的顏色基礎具有幾個不同的方面，不應簡化為單一分數。
